script: Spread and total were not saved for CHI@GB, so the script is form-only: Chicago's weeks 2-4 are a split run game (Kyle Monangai 50 carries/224 yards, D'Andre Swift 51/187) with Luther Burden (24 targets) and Rome Odunze (181 yards) carrying the pass game, while Green Bay is pass-leaning (Matthew Golden 25 targets, Christian Watson 24) behind a light run (Kaleb Johnson 20/80, Marshawn Lloyd 17/44). No number implies a shootout or a grind; Chicago can stay on the committee and Jordan Love has to throw into a Chicago defense that has leaked the middle.
who_goes_off: Kyle Monangai is the hot Chicago back at 224 yards and 4.48 yards per carry, but he is not on the board, and Swift's 187 on 51 carries is the listed share of that same committee. Among priced pass-catchers, Kalif Raymond (136 yards on 14 targets, only 65 air yards) is the Chicago profile that does not need bombs against a Green Bay defense with 6 passes of 20-plus on 128 attempts; Green Bay's own lines on Golden (57.5) and Watson (61.5) sit on their 59.7 and 61.3 per-game marks, so neither is mispriced to explode.
weak_spot: Chicago's pass defense is the middle of the field: 10.9 yards per attempt on 20 throws versus 6.44 left (41 attempts) and 7.74 right (38), so the matchup is linebackers, nickel, and safeties, not outside corners, and Chicago also allows 4.94 rush yards per carry. Green Bay has no location hole (left 6.78 on 46, middle 6.95 on 19, right 7.02 on 51); the real trait is explosive suppression, 6 gains of 20-plus yards on 128 pass attempts and 4.39 rush yards per carry allowed.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for CHI@GB, so the only fallout in the data is usage: Monangai already took 50 carries and 224 yards beside Swift's 51/187, Cole Kmet is down to 4 targets for 13 yards while Colston Loveland has 16 targets for 91, and Green Bay's backfield is Johnson 20/80 plus Lloyd 17/44 with no absence flagged.
qb_vs_blitz: Chicago's QB is 0.25 EPA per dropback versus the blitz (n=72) against 0.20 with no blitz, and Green Bay blitzes 40%, so pressure does not flip the Chicago script or force a checkdown spike. Jordan Love is -0.22 EPA versus the blitz (n=66) against +0.20 with no blitz, and Chicago also blitzes 40%, which is the dropback problem that can stall Golden and Watson rather than fuel a rushing-yard bump (Love has 2 carries for 4 yards in this window).

picks.why: Swift is at 187 rush yards on 51 carries over weeks 2-4, 62.3 per game at 3.67 yards per carry, while Monangai took 50 carries for 224 in the same games. Green Bay allows 4.39 yards per carry and only 11 runs of 10-plus; even 17 Swift carries at that 4.39 rate is about 75 yards, still under 84.5.

Raymond has 136 receiving yards on 14 targets over those three games, 45.3 per game, against a 27.5 line, on just 65 air yards (4.6 air yards per target). That short/YAC role does not need the 20-plus plays Green Bay has allowed only 6 times in 128 attempts, and 5 targets at Green Bay's roughly 7 yards per attempt still clears 27.5.
